source_evidence: Contributions are not tax deductible for federal income tax purposes, but your investments can grow tax free and remain so when withdrawn if used for qualified disability expenses.
answer: An ABLE account is a tax-advantaged way to save for qualified disability expenses. Contributions are not deductible for federal income tax purposes. However, investments in the account can grow tax free, and that tax-free treatment continues when money is withdrawn for qualified disability expenses.
